recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any broader cleanup of legacy model-info examples or old SubstanceSourceMaterial references should be handled under a separate issue such as FHIR-51930 rather than this reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-29724 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R R5 change request to move or add the SourceMaterialType classification from SubstanceSourceMaterial.sourceMaterialType to SubstanceDefinition.sourceMaterial, with cardinality 0..1, CodeableConcept, and an origin-of-raw-material definition.
initial_application: The request appears to have been applied by d0f7ef7e5f6db915f8378a2dc48f3eca68b7a3f1, which added SubstanceDefinition.sourceMaterial.type to the then-authoritative spreadsheet. The January 2021 source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried the element into structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml, and 9ee11711505abd6bd166111e6b5b4e0db63d8210 later added the SourceMaterialType binding.
additional_context: SubstanceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, while the separate SubstanceSourceMaterial resource was later removed from the active resource list by FHIR-51930. FHIR-55056 later reviewed SubstanceDefinition terminology, explicitly including substance-source-material-type bound to SubstanceDefinition.sourceMaterial.type, and resolved no-change for moving those value sets to THO. No direct Zulip or Confluence evidence for FHIR-29724 was found.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml already defines SubstanceDefinition.sourceMaterial.type as 0..1 CodeableConcept with the requested definition, a SourceMaterialType example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/substance-source-material-type, and the Source_Material.Source_Material_Type mapping.
